date: last-modified
---

Every `R##` / `Q##` / `DQ##` citation used across this site is exported from the internal
lit-review database (`lit_review` and `open_questions` tabs). Edit the source spreadsheet and
re-export `data/lit_review.csv` / `data/open_questions.csv` to update this page — it does not
call out to the sheet live.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
Click any `R##` / `Q##` / `DQ##` mention elsewhere on this site to jump straight to its entry
below.
:::

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import re

lit = pd.read_csv("data/lit_review.csv").fillna("")
oq = pd.read_csv("data/open_questions.csv").fillna("")

valid_ids = set(lit["ID"]) | set(oq["DQ ID"])
id_pattern = re.compile(r"\b(?:DQ|R|Q)\d+\b")

def linkify(text):
    """Turn any R##/Q##/DQ## mention in free text into a same-page anchor link."""
    if not text:
        return text
    return id_pattern.sub(
        lambda m: f"[{m.group(0)}](#{m.group(0)})" if m.group(0) in valid_ids else m.group(0),
        str(text),
    )
```

## Quick reference

### Lit-review sources (R##, Q##)

```{python}
lit[["ID", "Title", "Short citation", "Genre", "Relevance", "Status"]]
```

### Open questions (DQ##)

```{python}
oq[["DQ ID", "Question", "Status", "Priority"]]
```

## Source details

```{python}
#| output: asis
for _, row in lit.iterrows():
    rid = row["ID"]
    title = row["Title"] or rid
    link = row["Source Link"]
    title_md = f"[{title}]({link})" if link else title
    print(f"### {rid} — {title_md} {{#{rid}}}\n")

    byline = f"*{row['Short citation']}*" if row["Short citation"] else ""
    byline += f" · {row['Genre']}" if row["Genre"] else ""
    byline += f" · {row['Lit review section']}" if row["Lit review section"] else ""
    if byline:
        print(byline + "\n")

    if row["Short summary"]:
        print(f"**Summary.** {linkify(row['Short summary'])}\n")
    if row["Key findings / data quality issue"]:
        print(f"**Key findings.** {linkify(row['Key findings / data quality issue'])}\n")

    meta = []
    if row["Datasets"]:
        meta.append(f"**Datasets:** {row['Datasets']}")
    if row["Variables"]:
        meta.append(f"**Variables:** {row['Variables']}")
    if row["Methods"]:
        meta.append(f"**Methods:** {row['Methods']}")
    if meta:
        print(" · ".join(meta) + "\n")

    if row["Feeds deliverable"]:
        print(f"**Feeds:** {row['Feeds deliverable']}\n")
    if row["Related questions"]:
        print(f"**Related questions:** {linkify(row['Related questions'])}\n")

    print(f"**Relevance:** {row['Relevance']} · **Status:** {row['Status']}\n")

    if row["Other notes?"]:
        print(f"> {linkify(row['Other notes?'])}\n")

    print("\n---\n")
```

## Open questions (DQ##) — details

```{python}
#| output: asis
for _, row in oq.iterrows():
    rid = row["DQ ID"]
    print(f"### {rid} {{#{rid}}}\n")
    print(f"**Question.** {row['Question']}\n")

    meta = []
    if row["Raised by / where"]:
        meta.append(f"**Raised by:** {row['Raised by / where']}")
    if row["Datasets"]:
        meta.append(f"**Datasets:** {row['Datasets']}")
    if row["Variables"]:
        meta.append(f"**Variables:** {row['Variables']}")
    if meta:
        print(" · ".join(meta) + "\n")

    if row["Related sources"]:
        print(f"**Related sources:** {linkify(row['Related sources'])}\n")

    print(f"**Status:** {row['Status']} · **Priority:** {row['Priority']}\n")

    if row["Notes"]:
        print(f"> {linkify(row['Notes'])}\n")

    print("\n---\n")
```
